reponse: The Q1 payout fee is 0.45%, not 0.40%: a Slack message says Gil's review changed it and that the v3 deck is outdated [2]. That's the most recent word, dated November 17, 2026 [2], and it contradicts the v3 proposal and the draft customer notice, which both still state 0.40% [1][4]. Volume tiers are unchanged [2]: minus 0.05 points above $5M/month and minus 0.10 points above $20M/month [1]. A Pinecrest QBR had already been told 0.40% [3], and someone said they'd correct it with Rob [2]. Customer notices go out by December 1 [2].
